kabuto_of_imperial_authority.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，直到回合结束，对手不能用武器攻击。
刃碎
kabuto_of_imperial_authority.text_en:
When this defends, until end of turn, opponents can't attack with weapons.
Blade Break

kano.text_zh: 瞬间——支付3点资源：查看你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为"非攻击"行动牌，你可以放逐它。若如此做，本回合你可以将它当作瞬间使用。
kano.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Look at the top card of your deck. If it's a 'non-attack' action card, you may banish it. If you do, you may play it this turn as though it were an instant.

kano_dracai_of_aether.text_zh: 瞬间——支付3点资源：查看你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为“非攻击”行动牌，你可以放逐它。若如此做，本回合你可以将它当作瞬间使用。
kano_dracai_of_aether.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Look at the top card of your deck. If it's a 'non-attack' action card, you may banish it. If you do, you may play it this turn as though it were an instant.

kassai.text_zh:
若本回合你抽过牌，你启动剑攻击的费用减少1点资源。
每回合一次行动——放逐你坟场中的2张红色和2张黄色牌：本回合你控制的武器下一次命中英雄时，创造一个金币衍生物。再动
kassai.text_en:
If you've drawn a card this turn, your sword attacks cost {r} less to activate.
Once per Turn Action - Banish 2 red and 2 yellow cards from your graveyard: The next time a weapon you control hits a hero this turn, create a Gold token. Go again

kassai_cintari_sellsword.text_zh:
你每回合的第二次剑攻击使用费用减少1点资源。
在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合你用武器攻击过两次或更多，每有一次武器攻击命中，创造一个铜币衍生物。
kassai_cintari_sellsword.text_en:
Your second sword attack each turn costs {r} less.
At the beginning of your end phase, if you have attacked 2 or more times with weapons this turn, create a Copper token for each weapon attack that hit.

kassai_of_the_golden_sand.text_zh:
若本回合你抽过牌，你启动剑攻击的费用减少1点资源。
每回合一次行动——放逐你坟场中的2张红色和2张黄色牌：本回合你控制的武器下一次命中英雄时，创造一个金币衍生物。再动
kassai_of_the_golden_sand.text_en:
If you've drawn a card this turn, your sword attacks cost {r} less to activate.
Once per Turn Action - Banish 2 red and 2 yellow cards from your graveyard: The next time a weapon you control hits a hero this turn, create a Gold token. Go again

katsu.text_zh: 每回合第一次你控制的攻击行动牌命中时，你可以弃一张费用为0的牌。若如此做，从你的牌库中搜寻一张具有连击的牌，正面朝上放逐它，然后洗牌。本回合你可以使用它。
katsu.text_en: The first time an attack action card you control hits each turn, you may discard a card with cost 0. If you do, search your deck for a card with combo, banish it face up, then shuffle your deck. You may play it this turn.

katsu_the_wanderer.text_zh: 每回合第一次你控制的攻击行动牌命中时，你可以弃一张费用为0的牌。若如此做，从你的牌库中搜寻一张具有连击的牌，正面朝上放逐它，然后洗牌。本回合你可以使用它。
katsu_the_wanderer.text_en: The first time an attack action card you control hits each turn, you may discard a card with cost 0. If you do, search your deck for a card with combo, banish it face up, then shuffle your deck. You may play it this turn.

kavdaen_trader_of_skins.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：若一位英雄的生命高于其他所有英雄，该英雄失去1点生命并创造一个铜币衍生物。然后若一位英雄的生命低于其他所有英雄，该英雄获得1点生命。再动
kavdaen_trader_of_skins.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}: If a hero has more {h} than all other hero's, they lose 1{h} and create a Copper token. Then if a hero has less {h} than all other hero's, they gain 1{h}. Go again

kayo.text_zh:
你拥有1个武器区域。
你拥有的攻击行动牌在战斗链以外的任意区域期间获得+1力量。
在你每个行动阶段期间你第一次弃置力量为6或更高的牌时，创造一个力量衍生物。
kayo.text_en:
You have 1 weapon zone.
Attack action cards you own get +1{p} while they are in any zone other than the combat chain.
The first time you discard a card with 6 or more {p} during each of your action phases, create a Might token.

kayo_armed_and_dangerous.text_zh:
你拥有1个武器区域。
你拥有的攻击行动牌在战斗链以外的任意区域期间获得+1力量。
在你每个行动阶段期间你第一次弃置力量为6或更高的牌时，创造一个力量衍生物。
kayo_armed_and_dangerous.text_en:
You have 1 weapon zone.
Attack action cards you own get +1{p} while they are in any zone other than the combat chain.
The first time you discard a card with 6 or more {p} during each of your action phases, create a Might token.

kayo_berserker_runt.text_zh:
每当你使用基础力量为6或更高的攻击行动牌时，掷一枚六面骰。若掷出：
1至4——该攻击的基础力量减半（向下取整）。
5至6——该攻击的基础力量翻倍。

kayo_strong_arm.text_zh:
你以1个武器区域开始游戏。
瞬间——支付4点资源，横置此牌：你控制的目标攻击行动牌具有6点基础力量。
每当观众为你喝倒彩时，创造一个活力衍生物。
kayo_strong_arm.text_en:
You start the game with 1 weapon zone.
Instant - {r}{r}{r}{r}, {t}: Target attack action card you control has 6 base {p}.
Whenever the crowd boos you, create a Vigor token.

kayo_underhanded_cheat.text_zh:
你以1个武器区域开始游戏。
瞬间——支付4点资源，横置此牌：你控制的目标攻击行动牌具有6点基础力量。
每当观众为你喝倒彩时，创造一个活力衍生物。
kayo_underhanded_cheat.text_en:
You start the game with 1 weapon zone.
Instant - {r}{r}{r}{r}, {t}: Target attack action card you control has 6 base {p}.
Whenever the crowd boos you, create a Vigor token.

kelpie_tangled_mess.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌：攻击
行动——支付1点资源，横置此牌：横置目标英雄或盟友。再动
水葬
kelpie_tangled_mess.text_en:
Action - {t}: Attack
Action - {r}, {t}: {t} target hero or ally. Go again
Watery Grave

kick_the_hornets_nest.text_zh: 当对手的效果将此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，创造自信、力量、坚韧、活力衍生物各一个。
kick_the_hornets_nest.text_en: When an opponent's effect puts this into your graveyard from anywhere, create a Confidence, Might, Toughness, and Vigor token.

kimono_of_layered_lessons.text_zh:
翳装
瞬间——支付3点资源，将此牌翻为正面朝上：在此牌上放置一个+1防御指示物。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌。
kimono_of_layered_lessons.text_en:
Cloaked
Instant - {c}{c}{c}, turn this face-up: Put a +1{d} counter on this.
At the start of your turn, destroy this.

kindle.text_zh:
增幅1
若你手牌中没有牌，抽一张牌。
kindle.text_en:
Amp 1
If you have no cards in hand, draw a card.

king_kraken_harpoon.type_zh: 海盗 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
king_kraken_harpoon.text_zh: 钓鱼——当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄选择并展示其手牌中的一张牌。若其为非攻击行动牌，该英雄弃掉它，你创造一个金币衍生物。若本回合你启动过火炮，改为查看其手牌并由你选择那张牌。
king_kraken_harpoon.text_en: Go Fish - When this hits a hero, they choose and reveal a card from their hand. If it's a non-attack action card, they discard it and you create a Gold token. If you've activated a cannon this turn, instead look at their hand and you choose the card.

king_shark_harpoon.type_zh: 海盗 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
king_shark_harpoon.text_zh: 钓鱼——当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄选择并展示其手牌中的一张牌。若其为攻击行动牌，该英雄弃掉它，你创造一个金币衍生物。若本回合你启动过火炮，改为查看其手牌并由你选择那张牌。
king_shark_harpoon.text_en: Go Fish - When this hits a hero, they choose and reveal a card from their hand. If it's an attack action card, they discard it and you create a Gold token. If you've activated a cannon this turn, instead look at their hand and you choose the card.

kiss_of_death.type_zh: 刺客 行动·匕首 攻击
kiss_of_death.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄失去1点生命。
kiss_of_death.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, they lose 1{h}.

knick_knack_bric_a_brac.text_zh:
作为使用小玩意的额外费用，你可以摧毁你控制的任意数量的铜币、银币和/或金币。
从你的牌库中搜寻一张名称中含有护符、药剂或护身符的牌，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。每以此方式摧毁4个铜币、2个银币和/或1个金币，重复此过程。
knick_knack_bric_a_brac.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Knick Knack Bric-a-brac, you may destroy any number of Copper, Silver, and/or Gold you control.
Search your deck for a card with Amulet, Potion, or Talisman in its name, put it into the arena, then shuffle. For each 4 Copper, 2 Silver, and/or 1 Gold destroyed this way, repeat this process.

knife_through.text_zh:
隐匿
若本战斗链中你用匕首命中过，此牌获得再动。
knife_through.text_en:
Stealth
If you've hit with a dagger this combat chain, this gets go again.

knife_through_butter.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次匕首攻击获得+4力量。
本回合每当你攻击被标记的英雄时，该攻击获得再动。
再动
knife_through_butter.text_en:
Your next dagger attack this turn gets +4{p}.
Whenever you attack a marked hero this turn, the attack gets go again.
Go again

knives_out.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 攻击反应
knives_out.text_zh: 本回合你的匕首获得+1力量。

knock_em_off_their_feet.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，横置该英雄。
knock_em_off_their_feet.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, {t} them.

knucklehead.text_zh:
卡约专精
行动——摧毁此牌：掷一枚六面骰。直到回合结束，你的基础智力为掷出的数字。
淬炼
knucklehead.text_en:
Kayo Specialization 
Action - Destroy this: Roll a 6-sided die. Until end of turn, your base {i} is the number rolled.
Temper

koi_blessed_kimono.text_zh:
翳装
当此牌牌面朝下装备时，在你的回合开始时，若你的生命恰好为1点，你可以将此牌翻为正面朝上。
当此牌被翻为正面朝上时，摧毁它。从你的牌库中搜寻一张内息，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
koi_blessed_kimono.text_en:
Cloaked
While this is equipped face-down, at the start of your turn, if you have exactly 1{h}, you may turn this face-up.
When this is turned face-up, destroy it. Search your deck for an Inner Chi, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

korshem_crossroad_of_elements.name_zh: 元素十字路口·科尔谢姆
korshem_crossroad_of_elements.text_zh:
传奇
再动
每当一位英雄展示1张或更多牌时，该英雄选择其一；获得1点资源，或获得1点生命，或本回合其下一次攻击获得+1力量，或本回合其用于防御的下一张行动牌获得+1防御。
在结束阶段开始时，若没有英雄因牌效果获得过资源或生命，且没有英雄控制的牌或衍生物本回合获得过力量或防御加成，摧毁元素十字路口·科尔谢姆。
korshem_crossroad_of_elements.text_en:
Legendary
Go again
Whenever a hero reveals 1 or more cards, they choose 1; Gain {r}, or gain 1{h}, or their next attack this turn gains +1{p}, or the next action card they defend with this turn gains +1{d}.
At the beginning of the end phase, if no hero has gained {r} or {h} from a card effect and no card or token controlled by a hero has had {p} or {d} increased this turn, destroy Korshem, Crossroads of the Elements.

krakens_aethervein.type_zh: 法师 武器·法杖 （双手）
krakens_aethervein.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：对目标对手英雄造成1点秘法伤害。每以此方式造成1点秘法伤害，抽一张牌。
krakens_aethervein.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Deal 1 arcane damage to target opposing hero. Draw a card for each arcane damage dealt this way.

kunai_of_retribution.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 武器·匕首 （单手）
kunai_of_retribution.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付1点资源，当战斗链关闭时摧毁此牌：攻击。再动
kunai_of_retribution.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}, destroy this when the combat chain closes: Attack. Go again

kyloria.text_zh: 每当凯洛里亚命中英雄时，获得其控制的一个物品的控制权。若你没有以此方式获得物品的控制权，抽一张牌。
kyloria.text_en: Whenever Kyloria hits a hero, gain control of an item they control. If you don't gain control of an item this way, draw a card.
